generation_policy.review_gate: A candidate must pass identity, clothing, action, prop completeness, hands, feet, silhouette, and anchor readability checks before ISNet.

shared_visual_contract.framing: complete person and complete sound-related object with margin on every side
shared_visual_contract.silhouette: arms, hands, legs and prop edges separated wherever physically plausible
shared_visual_contract.accessory_policy: Use two or three attached, reconstruction-friendly accessories; avoid loose chains, long scarves, dangling tassels and transparent materials.
